description: This repository is a fork of embedpdf/embed-pdf-viewer. Renovate reads only the files the fork owns, listed in includePaths; everything else, including package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and the upstream workflows, changes only through upstream syncs. Fork packages that are pnpm workspace members are left out because their versions live in the upstream-owned pnpm-lock.yaml.

customManagers.description: Tool pins marked with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Rust crate updates that keep compatibility travel together; CI builds and tests them. A 0.x minor is a breaking change in Cargo, so those stay in their own pull requests.
Action updates other than majors travel together.
pnpm must equal packageManager in package.json, which upstream owns.
mise writes Java as openjdk-<version>, which the java-version datasource does not produce, and nothing in CI reads the pin.
A workaround pin (crates/epdf-node/Cargo.toml): it stays until napi-derive ships a backend that agrees with it, and is removed by hand then.
napi-derive decides whether the napi-derive-backend workaround pin still holds; check that comment before approving.
The image's Node base, mise.toml and the workflows' node-version move together. No CI builds the image, so every Node update waits for approval.
wasm-bindgen-cli in the Dockerfile and release-rust-viewer.yml must equal the wasm-bindgen crate pin in crates/epdf-web/Cargo.toml.
uniffi changes the generated Swift and Kotlin bindings, which no pull request CI builds.
A Rust toolchain bump touches the Xcode nm workaround and the published engine binaries.
No pull request CI covers these: the development image, the Android and .NET bindings, the Swift package and the Apple demo apps.
The .NET SDK pin lives in global.json, the Dockerfile and release-dotnet.yml, with a SHA-512 per archive.
Pins with checksums beside them: Renovate cannot compute those.
prBodyNotes: This pin has checksums Renovate cannot update. Run `python3 .devcontainer/check-pins.py --verify-checksums`: it names every file to change and prints the published hashes. The `Development image pins` check fails until they match.
